textos.Um único atraso deixa parte das falas fo:
A single delay leaves part of the lines out of place.

Sync section by section (recommended): EternalDub measures the delay at every second and assembles the dub piece by piece. Where the dub is missing a piece of the movie, silence goes in; where it has something that doesn't exist in the movie, that piece is removed (preferably in a pause). Only the dub becomes FLAC (lossless); the movie is not touched.
